mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 3-month prior value compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 2 months indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling recessionary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 4 months signals continued economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising GDPC1 periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12mo yoy > 3.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350,000) indicates labor market tightness and high consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 5.0% and RSAFS > 350,000 fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals active monetary tightening, reducing liquidity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.
